text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...My dream.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf! Symboli Rudolf surges up from the inside!
Here comes Rudolf! The undefeated Triple Crown horsegirl is now, right now—!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf claims the Triple Crown! The Triple Crown is hers!!
An immortal record! When this horsegirl resolves to win, victory is an absolute certainty!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ever since I saw that horsegirl. From that very moment, I—!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Guh... ngh... hmm—?
*yawn*... Ngh. What time is...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Three in the morning?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...*mumble* Did something happen...?
Lady Tsuroo-chaaan...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I-It's nothing! I'm sorry!
I just suddenly woke right up...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh... Seriously, why at this hour?
Do I really lack so much stamina that I can't even stay asleep...?!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(Mmh... Back to sleep! Sleep, darn it!!
Sleeping is part of training, too! Plus, today I have to—!)

A few days have passed since the selection race. Day after day, I've kept gathering info
on the horsegirls to make up for what I missed that day. However—
choice_data_list: (..."Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi.")

text_block_list.text:
I can't get the face of the horsegirl who lost her chance that day, just like me, out of my head.
Guilt and regret... such presumptuous feelings swirl within me.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Word's spreading about you! People are saying you're one motivated rookie!
Doing your research on the horsegirls, showing up to study sessions...

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
So, I'll let you in on a hot tip. Looks like the girls from the class
running in that last selection race... are at the training track right now!

I dash over to the training track grandstands.
Not on the turf... Not on the dirt, either. That leaves—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Oh, from the other day...
Are you here to observe, too, Trainer?
choice_data_list: ...! A-Ah, yeah! I heard your class was running...
...! Y-Yeah! I heard your class was running...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
In that case, this way, this way!
Spe-chan and the others are on the uphill course!

Led by the hand by Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi, I move to a spot with a clear view of the incline.
The two I had my eye on earlier happen to be doing a tandem run together right now.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa~! Looks like they're gonna clock another great time~!
What do you think?! How do the two of them look to you, Trainer?!
choice_data_list: Y-Yeah. They're amazing, but... um...
Y-Yeah. They're amazing, but... um...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...? Trainer?
choice_data_list: To be honest... I was hoping to see you run, too.
To be honest... I was hoping to see you run, too.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: M-Me...?! Wha?! ...Whaaat~~...?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Shall we run?! I can get changed right away!
Mentally, I've got enough stamina to easily do 3,000—*cough* *hack* *choke*!!
choice_data_list: A-Are you okay?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey now, Tsuroo-chan! Aren't you supposed to be resting until today?!
Ah... want me to grab some water?
choice_data_list: Wait. Tokai Teio?!

text_block_list.text:
The "Emperor," Tokai Teio. On the Classic Triple Crown trail,
she claimed victory in the Satsuki Sho and the Tokyo Yushun—making her a Double Crown horsegirl!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You too, Trainer! Tsuroo-chan is a fellow President fanatic,
just like me! Don't go pushing her too hard, if you please~!
choice_data_list: "President fanatic"...?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*... *wheeze*... Ehehe...
Truth is, we both really look up to President Symboli Rudolf...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Have you ever seen it before, Trainer?
The moment President Rudolf completed her undefeated Triple Crown!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I remember that incredible feat well.
Yeah, I remember that incredible feat well.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Right?! I mean, she was just so "strong"... It took my breath away.
Even though I'd watched so many other horsegirls race before that—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—I couldn't help dreaming about it. I want to become just like her.
I want to follow in her footsteps... to become a Triple Crown horsegirl who carries on her legacy—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...And Tsuroo-chan went right up to the Prez and begged her, too!
Telling her, "I want to run with you!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! Even though I hadn't hit my growth spurt at all.
...Yet the President still invited me to run tandem with her. We took turns—!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah!! That's right, the video from back then!!
Um, Trainer! If it's on video, I can show you how I run!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I was in tip-top shape that day, so I ran pretty darn well!
It's this video right here... Would you like to watch it?
choice_data_list: —! You'd really let me see it?
—! You'd really let me see it?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind, by all means!
It was a while back, so my running's a bit rougher than it is now, though.
—The footage captivates me completely.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, what do you think? She's taking it easy on me, but...
Still! *gasp* Pretty good, right?!
choice_data_list: Y-Yeah...!
Y-Yeah...!

text_block_list.text:
What captivates me isn't just her immense raw talent.
It's the spirit she displays while facing down Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
『*gasp*... Ahahaha—!
Not yet... I'm not done yeeeeeeet!』

—I've heard rumors. That Symboli Rudolf is so overwhelmingly powerful,
anyone running alongside her is crushed by the sheer gap and plunged into despair. And yet, she...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
『Here I come, President!! I can still—keep going!!
—Aaaaaaarrrrrrggghhh!!』
choice_data_list: What an exceptionally "strong" girl...!!
What an exceptionally "strong" girl...!!

text_block_list.text:
Watching a run so brimming with instinct and potential, my true feelings slip out.
An honest, unfiltered reaction... pure genuine admiration.
choice_data_list: I really want to see more of your races...!
I really want to see more of your races...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If you two are so interested in each other,
why don't you and Tsuroo-chan sign a provisional contract?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! Teio-chan?!
N-No way, Trainer's super busy, so...
choice_data_list: I-I'd love to! Please, let's do it!
I-I'd love to! Please, let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Eeeep?! A-Are you... sure...?
